literal: Human beings indeed they resemble, the base; like them, an exact likeness we have seen not.
translation: The base perfectly resemble normal human beings. We have never seen such an exact physical likeness anywhere else.
modern: கயவர்கள் பார்ப்பதற்கு நல்ல மனிதர்களைப் போலவே இருப்பார்கள். அவர்களைப் போன்ற ஒரு துல்லியமான ஒப்புமையை நாம் வேறு எங்கும் கண்டதில்லை.
explanation: This couplet uses biting irony to describe base or wicked people. It states that the only remarkable thing about the base is how perfectly they resemble actual human beings in their physical appearance. By saying 'we have never seen such an exact likeness', the poet implies that on the inside, they lack all human virtues and are entirely different from true humans.
